description: Source code for managing channel bookmarks in Mattermost, including CRUD operations, sorting, and WebSocket event publishing.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct providing methods for channel bookmark management.

methods.name: GetChannelBookmarks
methods.description: Retrieves bookmarks for a specific channel since a given timestamp.

methods.name: GetBookmark
methods.description: Retrieves a specific bookmark by ID, optionally including deleted ones.

methods.name: CreateChannelBookmark
methods.description: Creates a new channel bookmark and publishes a WebSocket event.

methods.name: UpdateChannelBookmark
methods.description: Updates an existing bookmark or replaces it if the owner matches, with WebSocket notification.

methods.name: DeleteChannelBookmark
methods.description: Deletes a bookmark and publishes a WebSocket event.

methods.name: UpdateChannelBookmarkSortOrder
methods.description: Updates the order of bookmarks within a channel and notifies via WebSocket.
